author: Subscriptor
body:
i hope its the last time someone makes the post like that and you actually update
why to update?

-staff said blocklag and all other lags are because the server is 1.7 and 1.8 and, i know the community wanted it, but most of community want blocklag to be fixed.  i myself hate 1.8 but i cannot handle the blocklag, there are no excuses, its not ping issues, this is purely avicus plugin problem. the gameplay of this server became literally not playable, its just not enjoyable anymore, thats why players are leaving. im tired of hearing "we are working on it" good if you are, but its going nowhere. update to 1.8 so it will have no blocklag, spectator or these glitches that just make gameplay not enojoyable. all staff say "we got all this fixed once we update to 1.8" THEN DO

-gameplay (including events) will be fair now, everyone on 1.8 version that everyone has same abilites, with blockhit possible on 1.7 people go on 1.7 and have huge advantage while other people with bad computers lag as hell there.

-less laggy, many people saying that 1.8 multiplies their fps and just makes it higher, and it will make the gameplay less laggy from the user's perspective.

-maps can finnaly use 1.8 blocks in it, so it makes builders have more creativity in maps and free to use many kinds of blocks


i really hope you will actually take this seriously because im done of excuses and staff defending the developers by "they are working on it!" im sorry but you've said that for more than 6 months and the community is expecting to see the gameplay fixed.
